description_en: Calls DescribeACLs to query the information about access control instances in a specified region
description_zh: 调用DescribeACLs查询指定地域下访问控制实例信息
kebab_example: aliyun smartag describe-acls --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --acl-ids acl-xhwhyuo43l0000000 --name test --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --acl-type acl-hardware --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeACLs

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the access control instance
parameters.help_zh: 访问控制实例所属的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The access control instance ID.

To query multiple access control instances simultaneously, separate multiple instance IDs with commas (,).
If this parameter is not specified, information about all access control instances in the current region is queried
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制实例ID。

若同时查询多个访问控制实例，多个实例ID请以半角逗号（,）隔开。
若不填写该项，则表示查询当前地域下所有访问控制实例的信息
parameters.name: acl_ids

parameters.help_en:
The name of the access control instance.

The name must be 2 to 100 characters in length and must start with an uppercase letter, lowercase letter, or Chinese character. The name can contain digits, underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制实例名称。

名称长度为2~100个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paginated query. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数。最大值为50，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The type of Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance that the access control instance can be associated with. Valid values:

acl-hardware: SAG hardware instance.
acl-software: SAG app instance
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制实例支持绑定的智能接入网关实例类型。取值：

acl-hardware：智能接入网关硬件实例。
acl-software：智能接入网关App实例
parameters.name: acl_type

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数
